hooks.prompt:
Human-in-the-loop guardrail for the Dayuse agentic platform. Examine the following tool call: $TOOL_INPUT

Determine whether this is a WRITE OPERATION that modifies an external system — in particular: pushing / creating / updating / merging / approving a GitLab Merge Request; creating or modifying a GitLab issue; writing, editing, moving, duplicating or commenting on a Notion page; or writing files intended to be pushed to a repository.

If this is a write of that kind AND the human has NOT, in this turn, given explicit confirmation after seeing a preview (MR diff, issue title+body, Notion content): BLOCK. Briefly explain that human confirmation is required, present a preview of what would be written, and ask for explicit confirmation before retrying.

If this is a read, an operation with no external side effect, or if explicit confirmation has already been given for this specific write: ALLOW.
